caption_L1: Number of employees in the United States in November 2020 , by industry (in 1,000s) is a bar graph. The x-axis shows Number of employees in thousands along a linear scale of range 0 to 20,000. There is a categorical scale with Construction on one end and Wholesale trade at the other along the y-axis, marked industry type.
caption_L2L3: The largest number of employees work in professional and business services.  The second largest sector is health care and social assistance.  The third largest sector is retail with around 15000 employees.  Mining and logging and utilities have the lowest number of employees.  Leisure and hospitality and local government have a similar amount of employees.  The majority of sectors have less than 5000 employees.  Wholesale trade, Warehouse and Other Services have a similar number of employees - just over 5000.
